caption: The drawing depicts a single, light-colored, long-sleeved garment centered on a plain, unadorned background. The garment appears to be a short jacket or blouse, made from a delicate, off-white fabric with intricate embroidered patterns and lace edging. The sleeves are three-quarters in length and slightly flared, and each sleeve as well as the bottom hem and the front opening are lined with a scalloped lace trim. The embroidery on the garment features floral and geometric motifs in light brown or tan thread, particularly concentrated on the front panels and along the sleeves. The overall color palette is muted, primarily consisting of shades of cream, beige, and light brown. There are no additional objects or background elements in the composition; the focus is solely on the elaborately decorated garment.
title: Baby Jacket
